title: Transcription Skill Input
description: Validated inputs for transcription skill execution via transcribe-anything

input.description: Path to local audio/video file, or URL (YouTube, Rumble, etc.)

model.description: Whisper model size. larger = more accurate but slower.

lang.description: ISO 639-1 language code (e.g. 'en', 'fr', 'de') or omit for auto-detection

device.description: Compute backend. cpu=universal, cuda=NVIDIA GPU, mlx=Apple Silicon, insane=fastest GPU, groq=cloud API

output_dir.description: Directory to write transcript output files. Defaults to current directory.

task.description: transcribe=same language output, translate=translate to English

hf_token.description: HuggingFace token for speaker diarization (insane backend only)

initial_prompt.description: Domain vocabulary hint to improve accuracy for technical, medical, or industry-specific content

batch_size.description: GPU batch size for throughput optimization
